label: The ratio test
subgoals: Form the ratio of consecutive terms
Take its limit and read L<1, L>1 or L=1
See why L<1 compares to a geometric series

visual.title: Compare the tail to a geometric series
visual.caption: The ratio of consecutive terms is the number the test reads. When it settles below one, the tail is smaller than a geometric series that converges.

predict.question: The ratio test concludes convergence when the limit L of |aₙ₊₁/aₙ| is:
predict.explain: L < 1 bounds the tail by a geometric series with ratio L. Here every ratio is 1/2, and the partial sums converge to 1.
